budget_unit: seconds of target audio per run (prereg E12: VoxCPM2 has continuous 6.25 Hz latents, no discrete audio tokens; match the Q-series budget of 23.05M frames @12.5 Hz = 1.844M audio-seconds per arm, tolerance +-3%)

vce3p.filter_note: OFFICIAL mechanism (train_voxcpm_finetune.py:138-156, max_batch_tokens 8192, batch 1): a unit whose packed length text_tokens + ceil(ceil(dur*25)/4) + 2 exceeds the model's 8192-position budget cannot be trained without silent truncation (packers.py:171-182 would cut the audio tail and the stop label); the 144 dropped units are the LONGEST ones (up to 15 min, packed 8193-15783). DOCUMENTED E12 DEVIATION from bit-exact Q-series data: VoxCPM2's context cannot hold them; Lead sign-off 2026-09-02: DROP via the official filter, do NOT truncate (truncation corrupts stop-supervision; the 8192 ceiling is a property of the model itself, the dropped >13-min units lie outside its deployable envelope; budget refilled by 3.67 passes per the prereg audio-seconds rule). Paper/limitations: the VoxCPM2 arm trains on context-fitting units = 81.8% of corpus seconds.
vce3p.expectation_note: shuffled epochs with drop_last; the 0.67 partial pass contributes its expected value (random subset of kept units); kept-unit durations are capped at ~609 s so the estimator is tight

vce2p.vram_note: batch 6 peaked 46.4/47.4 GB (P2 probe) -> batch 4 x accum 18 keeps the same 72 windows/step at 43.6 GB peak
